statement: Draw schematics so signal flow reads left to right: inputs and connectors on the left, processing in the middle, outputs on the right. Positive supply rails go toward the top of the sheet, ground toward the bottom.

Use standard reference designators (R1, C3, Q1, IC4/U4, D1, SW1) with values written compactly (100k, 0.1µF). Mark true wire junctions with a dot; unconnected crossings have no dot. Pin numbers are written outside the symbol body. Decoupling capacitors are drawn adjacent to the power pin they serve.
